primary_validator_requirements: load normative files by exact Git-object identity
reject any world, consequence label, target realization, or effect-cut mutation
check source consequence labels against the frozen source contract
check target realization equality for the two frozen worlds
derive factorization/kernel-preservation result without an expected-result parameter
emit a constructive witness only if the frozen model entails one
treat incomplete/malformed evidence binding as ASSURANCE_INCOMPLETE or infrastructure failure rather than inventing semantics
forbidden_after_freeze: rewriting the source ETag contract to fit the validator result
adding an IfMatch carrier to the target realization
removing W_STALE because it produces an inconvenient result
using E1's INCOMPLETE prediction as proof of the gold result
claim_boundary: This freeze records the preprimary gold model only. It does not itself declare preservation, regression, or incomplete assurance.
